verified_fact: Mount Kailash (6,638 m) in Tibet has never been climbed. China banned all attempts since 2001. It is considered the abode of Shiva in Hindu tradition, and sacred to Jain, Buddhist and Bon traditions too. The mountain forms a perfect pyramid shape, unusual for natural formations.
voiceover_script: Duniya ka ek pahad jo kabhi nahi chadhha gaya — Kailash! 6,638 meter uncha ye pahad Tibet mein hai. China ne 2001 mein climbing ban kar diya. Hindu manyata mein ye Mahadev ka niwas hai. Ajeeb baat — ye pahad bilkul pyramid shape ka hai jo natural formation mein bahut rare hai. 4 major rivers yahaan se shuru hoti hain: Ganga, Brahmaputra, Indus, Sutlej. Divya sthaan!

Kailash — Shiv Ka Ghar, Ab Tak Unclimbed! ⛰️

🔱 Mount Kailash unconquered Hindu sacred mountain Shiva abode

Mount Kailash (6,638 m) in Tibet has never been climbed. China banned all attempts since 2001. It is considered the abode of Shiva in Hindu tradition, and sacred to Jain, Buddhist and Bon traditions too. The mountain forms a perfect pyramid shape, unusual for natural formations.
